svg.title: Two Control Planes
svg.desc: Two animated reconciliation loops side by side. Figure A, for containers: a Kubernetes control plane (api-server, scheduler, controller, etcd) watches three worker nodes; a pod crashes, ready replicas drop from 6 to 5, and the controller schedules a replacement on another node. Figure B, for intent: an intent goes to an agent, which waits for a human approval switch, then calls tools (kubectl, terraform, aws, gh) through MCP and verifies the result.
svg.text: FIG. A CONTAINERS / FIG. B INTENT
Declare replicas; the controller makes it so.
State the goal. An agent plans; a human approves.
Two reconciliation loops: one converges containers, the other converges intent.
